# kcore_gpus (Data Source)

GPUs and vGPU slices reported by the controller, including the bound profile and the profiles a card can create.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kcore_gpus" "node_193" {
  node_id = "node-193"
}
```





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `node_id` (String) Limit the inventory to one node. Empty lists every node.

### Read-Only

- `devices` (List of Object) GPUs and vGPU slices reported by the controller. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String)
- `assignable` (Boolean)
- `assigned_vm` (String)
- `kind` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `node_id` (String)
- `parent` (String)
- `profile` (String)
- `profiles` (List of String)
- `role` (String)
